response.text:
I'll propose voiding the duplicate invoice 801 (open, unpaid, duplicate of paid 602) and reversing its journal 2488 so AP and expense are not double-counted.

Reasoning: 801 is an exact duplicate of 602 (same vendor, amount, date; INV_NO differs only by a leading space). Journal 2488 duplicates journal 2005's lines exactly. The correction reverses 2488 by posting the mirror image in open period 11 (the period of the original): credit the expense accounts and debit 2000 for the same amounts. Net effect: 2488 + reversal = 0, leaving only 2005 for the 9478.36 invoice. Invoice 801 is set to V, which is permitted because this is a duplicate_invoice finding. Invoice 602 and journal 2005 are untouched.
